brief:
The US Central Command (CENTCOM) withdrew a map posted on its official social media accounts after the image depicted the West Bank and Gaza Strip as part of Israeli territory, Shehab Wire reported. The map had colored both Palestinian areas within the region represented as Israel without displaying separate or distinct borders to denote Palestinian land.

The controversial posting triggered immediate criticism over its territorial representation. CENTCOM removed the map from its official channels following the public backlash and controversy generated by the image's depiction of Palestinian territories.
